visual_synopsis: A hotel receptionist in a white shirt and tie walks a mustachioed man in a black overcoat and his young blonde companion up the white staircase and into a guest room, talking them through it with a lot of hand-rubbing and gesturing while the couple looks around. After he leaves, the woman is in bed in a nightdress, the man comes back from the bathroom in a singlet and gets in beside her, and the two end up giggling and wrestling over the pillows.
